description: Verify Wave0 produced shared foundation evidence: _INDEX.md and README.md exist, 00-shared-*.md reference files exist (count_floor >=1), per-topic thin YAML exists in artifacts/wave0/ and passes ReferenceMetadata schema validation, trace evidence present, status values point to wave0→wave1.

rules.failure_message: Missing file: reference/_INDEX.md. Write a canonical Markdown table inventory of all reference files with columns: ref_file, source_type, trust_level, tier, related_topic, source_layer, acceptance_status, date_landed.
Missing file: reference/README.md. Write a brief human-readable overview of the flat reference directory convention.
Missing directory: reference/. Create the directory and populate with 00-shared-*.md reference files.
Fewer than 1 00-shared-*.md reference file in reference/. Create at least one shared foundation reference file per shared-reference-template.md.
A 00-shared-*.md file contains placeholder source_url (example.com). Delete the placeholder file and write a real reference or suppl-failure-r{N}.md instead.
Missing per-topic thin YAML: artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Search and collect at least foundation floor count of references for each topic in the topic_registry.
Reference metadata in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml fails schema validation. Each entry must have url, title, retrieved_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and topic_tag.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference metadata entries in artifacts/wave0/{topic}/source.yaml. Collect at least the foundation floor count for each topic.
Missing trace event: wave0_completion. The phase body requires recording this event in rb_trace.jsonl before running the gate.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'wave0_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave1_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
